doneRows now counts EXPERIENCE/EDUCATION/ACHIEVEMENT with countRoles, which skips an entry that continues() the one before it, so a 20-bullet role split 15+5 by splitBulletsForEntries reads '1 role'. ReadingViewModelTest.experienceCountSkipsEntriesThatContinueThePreviousOne fails on 48014c03 (count 2). Prototype RR row values ('3 roles', '1 degree', '6 found') count logical items, which matches.

ContentResolverResumeTextSource.read now returns TooLarge when the bounded read (limit + 1 bytes) overflows, before any parse; unknown-SIZE oversize files map to UploadFailureKind.TooLarge and the 5 MB copy. The remembered id lives only in the view model, so re-entering Fill in myself (or process death) still appends a second confirmed role (low finding).

findings.rule: 274-c8; round-1 medium (one confirmed role per Fill in myself pass, I.1)
findings.trigger: Upload -> Fill in myself, type 'Business Analyst' / 'Infosys', Continue (role W-xxxx saved, confirmed). Back from Review, Back from Manual to Upload (the Manual entry is popped and its ViewModelStore cleared), tap Fill in myself again. The new ManualProfileViewModel prefills name/phone/city from the profile but leaves job title and company blank, and savedRoleId is null. The user retypes the role and taps Continue, and SaveManualProfileUseCase appends a second USER_STATED confirmed role. Process death between Continue and Back has the same result, because savedRoleId is a plain field and not in SavedStateHandle.
findings.title: Remembered manual role id is lost when the Manual entry is recreated, so re-entering Fill in myself duplicates the confirmed role
findings.proof: ManualProfileViewModelTest: viewModel() saves 'Business Analyst'/'Infosys'; create a second viewModel() on the same TestProfileRepository; assert uiState jobTitle/company are prefilled, then onContinue and assert exactly one EXPERIENCE entry. Fix: in init, seed jobTitle/company and savedRoleId from the profile's USER_STATED, bullet-less, dateless EXPERIENCE entry (the shape this screen writes), as it already does for name/phone/city.

round1_adjudication.finding: medium SaveManualProfileUseCase duplicate confirmed role on re-Continue
round1_adjudication.note: The same-view-model path is fixed and tested. The replace guard cannot touch a fact the user did not create here: ids are never reused (neverUsedId), savedRoleId only comes from this view model's own save diff, and IMPORTED or bulleted entries fail isManualRole. idsBefore is read separately from the use case's own read, but the use case adds at most one entry and a failed save leaves savedRoleId unchanged. The sibling re-entry and process-death path is still open (low finding above). The isManualRole guard itself is untested; deleting it passes every test. It is defence in depth only, so no finding.

countRoles is applied to EDUCATION and ACHIEVEMENT too, which is correct: splitBulletsForEntries splits any category, and the prototype counts logical items. Known limit: the offline parser folds bullet-marked achievements into one 'Achievement' entry, so the demo flavour can show '1 found'. That is pre-existing parser behaviour, not caused by this diff.
The limit + 1 bounded read now yields TooLarge before any parse. Memory is bounded at about 5 MB + 8 KB plus one toByteArray copy. TooLarge.byteSize is a lower bound, but the UI does not display it.
TmrFitText with breakAfter separators; baseline and layout test added. The layout test would fail on old code only because TmrFitTextLayoutKey is absent there, not through its assertion. Acceptable.

integrate_notes: TmrFitText.kt at this head is byte-identical to origin/revamp/w4-base apart from internal -> public on TmrFitText and TmrFitTextLayoutKey. It does not conflict textually with w4-base's D47 rewrite. The PR base origin/revamp/273-sign-in still has the old onTextLayout-shrink TmrFitText, so take this head's body at integrate.

#329 (origin/revamp/277-job-analysis) adds a public TmrWholeWordText in component/TmrWholeWordText.kt with the same WholeWordAutoSize body but no breakAfter and no semantics or layout key. It has textAlign. There is no file conflict, but after both merge core:designsystem exports two public whole-word text composables. D69 names TmrWholeWordText as the public API. At integrate, either give TmrWholeWordText breakAfter (and the read-as semantics) and point TmrFitText/ResumeFileCard/TmrFileCard/TmrTextField at it, or keep TmrFitText and make TmrWholeWordText delegate. Do not keep two divergent bodies.

TmrFitTextLayoutKey is a test hook now in the public API. Compose's own SemanticsActions.GetTextLayoutResult is cleared by clearAndSetSemantics, which is why the key exists. That is acceptable, but keep only one such key after the consolidation above.

#281 (origin/revamp/281-profile) ProfileViewModel.entryCount counts every entry, so a split role reads '1 role' on Reading and 'Experience 2' on Profile. Move countRoles next to continues() in core:model (BulletLimits.kt) and use it in both when the two lanes meet.

The future Review screen (#275, currently NavKeyPlaceholder): if it lets the user edit the manual role's title or dates without adding bullets, Back to Manual + Continue will overwrite those edits with Manual's stale fields, because isManualRole does not compare content. Revisit SaveManualProfileUseCase's guard when Review becomes editable.
